visual_records.analytical_purpose: It exposes the full intended reasoning route before details.
visual_records.exact_reading: The Summary opens with more than 21,000 words of traffic, then previews time omission, iRank, closeness, time/text restoration, critical-value review, baseline comparison, and biological transfer.
visual_records.next_action: Bind every preview to a later formula, table, figure, demonstrated/prospective status, or warning.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The chart motivates group-activity and communication-direction features.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 1 compares total, outgoing, and incoming conversation activity for known conspirators and non-conspirators; every conspirator bar is visibly higher.
visual_records.next_action: Recompute exact denominators and test role, exposure, and label confounding.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The visual supports the initiator/receiver behavioral discussion.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 2 shows outgoing and incoming suspicious-topic messages for the two labeled groups, with the conspirator bars much higher.
visual_records.next_action: Separate message count, person count, direction, repeated topics, and uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It is the paper's variable contract for later formulas.
visual_records.exact_reading: The full-page table binds G, node classes, directed links, topic-labeled link sets, degree, centrality, IR, alpha, message counts, harmonic terms, scaling weights, and closeness heuristic.
visual_records.next_action: Reconcile symbol drift, direction, domains, units, zero cases, and unused definitions.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The layout makes model convenience and data-derived premises distinguishable.
visual_records.exact_reading: The page separates simplifications about topics, time, contents, and multi-topic messages from behavior assumptions inferred from the sample statistics.
visual_records.next_action: Version each assumption, diagnostic, enabled calculation, failure consequence, and later repair.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: These structures define the initial ranking state.
visual_records.exact_reading: The page shows the informal three-factor decomposition, the piecewise known/unknown IR score, relative-closeness d(n), and inverse-distance group closeness.
visual_records.next_action: Audit scaling, maxima, harmonic terms, denominators, disconnected paths, labels, and score semantics.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It converts a group-closeness intuition into a visible anomaly pattern.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 3 plots degree of closeness to the non-conspirator group against degree of closeness to the conspirator group and circles several low-trend outliers.
visual_records.next_action: Define both axes, a reproducible outlier rule, uncertainty, and alternatives before using it as a feature.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It defines the propagation stage after initialization.
visual_records.exact_reading: The piecewise update combines two directed neighbor sums; the adjacent line states an incoming alpha sum of one and claims eventual convergence by a Markov property.
visual_records.next_action: Resolve adjacency direction, alpha indices, stochasticity, convergence conditions, and stopping tolerance.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The table is the stated basis for the four Task 1 standardizing weights.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 1 gives counts 26, 6, 5, 10 for group-to-group messages and 31, 3, 28, 7 for suspicious-message directions.
visual_records.next_action: Reproduce the weight arithmetic with frozen denominators and sample uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It hands an internal score to an investigation-priority interpretation.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 2 ranks Node 81 at 0.8571, Node 51 at 0.6244, Node 16 at 0.6142, then Nodes 33, 57, 60, 28, 79, and 10.
visual_records.next_action: Predeclare the candidate set, threshold, corroboration, calibration, and error costs.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It makes the priority distribution and post hoc cutoff visible.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 4 orders node bars around a manually drawn horizontal critical line; a small upper cluster is visually separated from most scores.
visual_records.next_action: Freeze the threshold before inspection and report false positives, false negatives, and score uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It turns leader premises into named visual candidates.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 5 places two points, identified in prose as Node 16 Jerome and Node 10 Dolores, above the main neighborhood-connectivity versus average-shortest-path cloud.
visual_records.next_action: Define axes and anomaly rule and validate with independent leader labels and alternative structures.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The paired tables show a changed condition passing through the same model to a new rank.
visual_records.exact_reading: Task 2 counts become weights 1.3, 1.2, 1.13, and 1.27; after 1000 iterations Table 4 ranks Node 16 at 0.94099 and Node 81 at 0.86962, followed by Node 51 at 0.63188 and Node 56 at 0.60522.
visual_records.next_action: Correct the Task 1 caption, reproduce weight arithmetic, and compare Task 1/Task 2 under a frozen metric.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The map lets a reader inspect score concentration and network position together.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 6 renders the full message network with node size and color apparently tied to Task 2 score; Nodes 81, 75, 76, 64, 63, and 62 are visually prominent.
visual_records.next_action: Publish color/size legends, layout seed, edge direction, label status, and avoid treating prominence as guilt.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The page shows authors using limitations to define the next modeling agenda.
visual_records.exact_reading: The evaluation moves from claimed dynamic efficiency to two explicit weaknesses: static loss of time/sequence and absence of a pre-review critical value.
visual_records.next_action: Retain the pivot while requiring measured complexity, frozen thresholds, and implemented repairs.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The workflow exposes the intended handoffs despite unavailable original messages.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 7 shows Text -> Extraction -> Network Representation -> Query -> Answer.
visual_records.next_action: Specify corpus, extraction labels, representation, query, output, reviewer, privacy, and evaluation at every arrow.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It formalizes the proposed content-to-link handoff.
visual_records.exact_reading: The displayed model changes notation from IR to PR, averages incoming and outgoing content-weighted sums, clips f(m)-based alpha at zero, and also states an alpha sum of one.
visual_records.next_action: Resolve notation, training labels, negative scores, denominator, clipping, normalization, and convergence before execution.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: The paired diagrams demonstrate the intended local effect of the repair.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 8 holds one node neighborhood fixed: the original suspicious-link share is 2/(2+1+1)=0.5, while the proposed content weighting gives 0.9/(0.9+0.1+0)=0.9.
visual_records.next_action: Classify this as a constructed mechanism example, then test it on labeled messages under the same downstream metric.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It converts admitted gaps into operational next steps.
visual_records.exact_reading: The page recommends more links, time series, text analysis, and semantic network analysis, then names the intended decisions: richer interactions, initiator detection, scalable message screening, and pattern-change recognition.
visual_records.next_action: Assign data, metric, implementation, validation, privacy, and stopping requirements to each recommendation.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: It closes the paper with a structural transfer example.
visual_records.exact_reading: The second Figure 7 shows a dense cell network with larger dark nodes, including 12, 11, and 6, after prose substitutes inverse distance and known infected seeds.
visual_records.next_action: Treat the diagram as prospective; define biological dynamics, labels, units, baselines, and outcome validation before reuse.
